verdict.rationale: Vercel documents adding custom domains with DNS management and automatic SSL. It also offers a REST API (with a live OpenAPI spec) and a CLI that manages DNS records and certificates, so domain provisioning can plausibly be automated. Routing middleware can rewrite requests per host. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly ties these pieces to a multi-tenant, per-customer domain workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit REST API endpoint for adding domains to a project, documented multi-tenant or platform guidance for customer domains, host-based tenant routing examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
